title: file upload reuse already uploaded
rule: File upload: let users reuse a file already uploaded.
pass_when: A file already uploaded in the journey can be reused without re-picking from disk.
fail_when: Every step that needs the file requires a fresh upload with no reuse.
overview: Let users reuse a file already uploaded in the journey without re-picking from disk.
apply_when: A later step needs a file the person already uploaded earlier in the journey.
not_when: Not for first-time uploads with no prior file in the session.
agent_hint: Offer reuse of an already-uploaded file; do not force a fresh disk pick each step.
description: When a journey already has an uploaded file, let the person reuse it on later steps instead of forcing another pick from disk. Reuse saves time and avoids accidental different-file uploads mid-flow. The control should make an already-uploaded file available where the journey still needs it. Fail if every step that needs the file requires a fresh upload with no reuse path. Use this in multi-step forms that ask for the same file more than once.
